definitions.gloss: during that time; meanwhile; in the meantime
definitions.explanation: refers to the period of time while something else is happening

examples.japanese: ⟦{電話|でんわ}している→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧。その{間|あいだ}、⟦{待|ま}っていて→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: I'm on the phone. Wait for me in the meantime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出来|でき}る⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}→三十分：09672_sanjuppun⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。その{間|あいだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The cooking will take 30 minutes. Let's clean in the meantime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧にいた。その{間|あいだ}、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{継|つ}いだ→引き継ぐ：12458_hikitsugu⟧。
examples.english: He was overseas. During that time, I took over his work.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧ (that) + ⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧ (interval, between)

PRONUNCIATION:
- その{間|あいだ} - standard reading
- その{間|かん} - more formal/literary

USAGE:
- その{間|あいだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - during that time (for doing something else)
- その{間|あいだ} - meanwhile (standalone)

COMMON PATTERNS:
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧ + noun pattern:
- ⟦そのため→そのため：08500_sonotame⟧ - therefore
- ⟦その{後|ご}→その後：08501_sonogo⟧ - after that
- ⟦その{前|まえ}→その前：08502_sonomae⟧ - before that
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{時|とき} - at that time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- その{間|あいだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - during that time
- ⟦{一方|いっぽう}→一方：01739_ippou⟧ - meanwhile, on the other hand
- ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧ - until then
